teaser.en: The 'wild vwivwi': a yam whose name itself is a warning not to eat it.
teaser.sw: 'Vwivwi wa porini': kiazi kikuu ambacho jina lake lenyewe ni onyo kwamba kisiliwe.
teaser.dg: '*Vwivwi* ya weruni': *yam* ambayo dzinare renye ni onyo kukala taifwaha kuriwa.

summary.en: Vwivwi koma is the Zanzibar yam, a large climbing yam with heart-shaped leaves. The Digo label it 'wild', koma, a word that marks a plant as poisonous or not for eating.
summary.sw: Vwivwi koma ni kiazi kikuu cha Zanzibar, mtambaa mkubwa wa jamii ya viazi vikuu wenye majani ya umbo la moyo. Wadigo huuita 'wa porini', koma, neno linaloashiria kuwa mmea ni sumu au haufai kuliwa.
summary.dg: *Vwivwi koma* ni *Zanzibar yam*, *yam* kulu inayokpwera, yenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo. Adigo anaiha 'ya weruni', *koma*, neno rinaroonyesa kukala mmea ni wa sumu au taufwaha kuriwa.

about.en:
*Vwivwi koma* is a vigorous twining climber that grows each year from a large underground tuber. Its big, glossy, heart-shaped leaves end in a long drip tip, and the vines carry round aerial bulbils in the leaf angles.

The tubers and bulbils of this species are known to be highly poisonous.
about.sw:
*Vwivwi koma* ni mtambaa wenye nguvu unaojizungusha, unaochipuka kila mwaka kutoka kiazi kikubwa kilicho chini ya ardhi. Majani yake makubwa, yanayong'aa, yenye umbo la moyo huishia kwa ncha ndefu ya kudondoshea maji, na mitambaa huzaa vitunguu-hewa vya mviringo kwenye pembe za majani.

Viazi na vitunguu-hewa vya spishi hii vinajulikana kuwa na sumu kali.
about.dg:
*Vwivwi koma* ni mmea wenye nguvu unaokpwera kpwa kudzilinga-linga kpwenye mimea yanjina, na chila mwaka unamera kula chiazi chikulu cha tsini. Makodzage ni makulu, ganang'ala, ga umbo ra moyo, na ganamala kpwa ntsa ndire. Dzulu ya mmea, phatu makodza ganaphotuluka, kunamera viazi vidide vya mviringo.

Viazi vya tsini na viazi vidide vya dzulu vya aina hino vinamanyikana kukala ni vya sumu kali sana.

where.en: It climbs through coastal forest, thicket and bush edges along the East African coast and inland.
where.sw: Hutambaa katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka vizito na kingo za vichaka kando ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki na bara.
where.dg: Inakpwera kpwenye matsaka, vitsaka na kanda-kanda za vitsaka, pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki na bara.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the word *koma*, 'wild', is one of the Digo labels that warns a plant is poisonous or should not be eaten, as in *mtungudza koma* for the wild relative of the eggplant. *Vwivwi koma* is the wild, poisonous *vwivwi*, which implies there is an edible *vwivwi* too, though Pakia did not collect it.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa neno *koma*, 'wa porini', ni mojawapo ya lebo za Kidigo zinazoonya kuwa mmea ni sumu au haupaswi kuliwa, kama katika *mtungudza koma* kwa jamaa wa porini wa mbilingani. *Vwivwi koma* ni *vwivwi* wa porini mwenye sumu, jambo linaloashiria kuwa kuna pia *vwivwi* unaoliwa, ingawa Pakia hakuukusanya.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala neno *koma*, 'ya weruni', ni kahi ya maneno ga Chidigo ganagoonya kukala mmea ni wa sumu au taufwaha kuriwa, dza *mtungudza koma*, mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya mtungudza (*eggplant*). *Vwivwi koma* ni *vwivwi* ya weruni, ya sumu, na dzambo hiri rinaonyesa kukala kuna *vwivwi* inayoriwa piya, ela vwivwi hiyo si kahi ya mimea ariyotsola Pakia.

names.en: Pakia records *vwivwi koma*, 'wild *vwivwi*'. In English it is the Zanzibar yam, after its scientific name. No Swahili name is recorded. The edible *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*) is another Digo yam.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *vwivwi koma*, '*vwivwi* wa porini'. Kwa Kiingereza ni *Zanzibar yam*, kutokana na jina lake la kisayansi. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. *Mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*) unaoliwa ni kiazi kikuu kingine cha Kidigo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *vwivwi koma*, '*vwivwi* ya weruni'. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *Zanzibar yam*, kula dzinare ra chisayansi. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. *Mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), inayoriwa, ni *yam* yanjina ya Chidigo.

reason.sw: aina nyingine ya porini yenye sumu iitwayo 'koma'
reason.dg: mmea wanjina wa weruni wa sumu, wenye dzina *koma*
